scenarios.name: ok-echo
scenarios.code:
import json, sys, hashlib
raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
data = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({'echo_round': data['round'], 'echo_seed': data['sub_seed'],
                  'stdin_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                  'stdin_bytes': len(raw)}))

scenarios.name: ok-unicode
scenarios.code:
import json, sys
data = json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode('utf-8'))
probe = {'cjk': '中文样本数据', 'emoji': '🚀📈', 'combining': 'éclair',
         'rtl': 'مرحبا', 'shapes': '◐◓◑◒'}
encoded = json.dumps(probe, ensure_ascii=False)
assert json.loads(encoded) == probe
print(json.dumps({'echo_round': data['round'], 'echo_seed': data['sub_seed'],
                  'unicode_roundtrip': True,
                  'chars': sum(len(value) for value in probe.values())}))

scenarios.name: ok-sleep-2s
scenarios.code:
import json, sys, time
data = json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode('utf-8'))
